title: OrbitSet answers ok:true when no ModelScene is active: it discards its own refusal
description: ixdar.automation.endpoints.ui.OrbitSet makes a first main-thread call that returns the 'no ModelScene is active' failure, but the endpoint ignores that result and answers ok:true, so orbit-set on a 2D scene (ixdar-canvas, circle-canvas) reports success while nothing moved. Found by ENG-34's before/after route probe (eng-34 worktree tmp/eng34-*-circle-canvas.txt); behaviour unchanged there. Return the failure when the scene is not a ModelScene.
definition-of-done:
1. orbit-set on a scene that is not a ModelScene returns failure("no ModelScene is active") with ok:false.
2. orbit-set on mesh-viewer still moves the orbit and answers ok:true.
testing-plan: 1. uv run ixdar-cli: orbit-set on circle-canvas and on mesh-viewer; paste both responses.
